items.title: Coherent (COHR) Starts Sampling 300mm Silicon Carbide Substrates For AI Infrastructure
items.summary: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) has begun customer sampling of its advanced 300mm high thermal conductivity silicon carbide substrates for AI infrastructure. The new 300mm substrates are aimed at AI data centers and high performance computing systems that face rising demands for thermal management and material scalability. The sampling program is intended to give chipmakers and system providers early access to Coherent's silicon carbide materials for testing in next generation AI hardware. This move...

items.title: Coherent (COHR) Stock Could Be A Bargain On Cash Flow Yet Priced For Perfection On Earnings
items.summary: Coherent stock has surged over the past few years, yet the valuation signals are split, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to upside while market multiples lean expensive. Coherent has delivered a very large return of around 8x over the past 3 years, which puts extra focus on whether today’s price still reflects its fundamentals. items.title: AI and Energy Aren't Enough to Lift the Stock Market

items.title: AXT Soars Again on Monday to Lead Optics Stocks. Coherent and Lumentum Rally on Indium Phosphide Price Hikes
items.summary: A Taipei supply report on indium phosphide just sent shockwaves through the optics sector, and the institutional money that quietly positioned ahead of Monday's session suggests this squeeze may have much further to run.

items.title: Chip Stocks Make Another Run at a New Bull Market
items.summary: After falling short last week, the chip stock benchmark is making another run at a new bull market.  The PHLX Semiconductor Index was up 1.7% to 12,630.66 on Monday.  It needs to close above 12,536.99 to exit its bear market after 21 days and begin a new bull market.
